records.summary: Leah Hunt had the first appointment on the first day the Haifa office reopened: interviews were short but the visit took over 2 hours due to computer problems, with an entrance detour and security delay, staff friendly and everything otherwise smooth.
practices: Entrance is through a guard station at the garden with the arches while construction fences block the usual west stairs
Personal protection items are checked in at security and retrieved with a slip when leaving
Many walk-ins are already waiting at 8am
